HEAD 2d313cc, 447 tests pass in ~166 s, 10 commits ahead of origin/main and NOT PUSHED. Push is the last step of validate_dsrc_3 and has not happened.

THE GOAL: the paper is a deployment story. The simulation replicates that MAPPO works under the deployment-measured sensing model. NOT plan_simulations.md section 8's nine-figure study. Recorded as task 89 and as the memory dsrc-paper-is-a-deployment-story.
The deliverable is ONE MAPPO run at mappo_sumo plus its evaluation against no_av. outputs/checkpoints/ is empty; every earlier SUMO run is invalid.

VALIDATOR ROUND 3 REPORTED AND ITS FINDINGS ARE UNADDRESSED. Two confirmed defects: (a) close() catches only Exception, so a BaseException leaves _LIVE set and _running True and every later reset in the process raises -- the same cascade 3562483 fixed, one step to the side; the fix is a finally block, and note close() raising inside reset's own handler also masks the original exception. (b) reset() does not clear _last_metrics, so get_episode_summary() and get_global_state()['step_metrics'] return the previous episode's values on a freshly reset env.

ROUND 3, claims that do not reproduce: the optimization: block of mappo_sumo.yaml states mean +0.2737 over 300 steps; no combination of episode length and warm-up reproduces it (300/300 gives +1.1165, 600/300 gives +0.8313 which matches the header comment). The same block says queue_length_total is the largest term at -1.30; measured it is -0.4497 and throughput_recent is +1.2437, 2.8x larger. The block contradicts the header of its own file and still carries the retracted 'about 1.28'.

ROUND 3: the recorded arm tables reproduce EXACTLY on seeds (3,7,11,19,23) -- the validator recovered them by exhaustive search because no committed script produces the tables. On seeds (7,17,27,37,47) the 10 m/s gain is +6.7% and over seeds 0..9 it is +14.1% (t=3.6), against the recorded +17.6%. Direction and significance hold; the recorded magnitude is at the optimistic end of the seed distribution. COMMIT THE MEASUREMENT SCRIPTS.

ROUND 3 mutation: 53 of 78 killed. Survivors that change a reported number: R6 (jam_fraction aggregated as max not mean -- reward moves +1.2121 to -0.2668), R7 (queue_length_total hardcoded 0, +0.4497), F6e (new_collision_count hardcoded 0 -- the existing test compares two zeros), R11 (_lane_index ordinal flattened -- 11.1% of observation slots move and the whole suite stays green), R9, R8, R20, F1g, F3i.

ROUND 3, other real findings: get_segment_metrics(snapshots) ignores its argument when the cache is warm (latent, no caller passes it); all_lane_av_low_speed_occupancy has NO entry in DEFAULT_REWARD_WEIGHTS so its aggregate reaches the reward at weight zero, and the comment at env.py:463-466 wrongly attributes the -2.0 weight to it; the critic's `time` feature is scaled by 120.0 so at duration_steps 600 it reaches 5.0 against a maximum of 1.0 before, one of only three top-level critic inputs now far outside its normalisation range; rollout_steps 512 < duration_steps 600 means the last 88 steps of every episode are never sampled.

TASK 91 FINDING, unchanged by the fix: 48.5% of the roadblock firings at 10 m/s had a CLEAR downstream segment, which is obstruction by the project's own definition. Report the headline under both definitions.
The reward does not rank the arms by arrivals -- see memory dsrc-sumo-reward-does-not-rank-by-throughput. That is what the exemption is meant to address and it is unverified.
